item.title: Some Nvidia Directors Still Push to Bring Back Jensen Huang
item.description:
Semafor reports that some Nvidia directors are still pushing to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO despite Chair Harvey Jones's public denial, and Huang discussed a return with at least one director before Tuesday's earnings report. The board vote covered only the resignation, and Nvidia's bylaws allow a simple majority of the 10 remaining directors to appoint a CEO without a shareholder vote, while other directors are narrowing the search to candidates including Arm CEO Rene Haas and Marvell CEO Matt Murphy.

item.title: Nvidia Interim CEO Denies Propping Up Risky Neocloud Buyers
item.description:
Nvidia interim CEO and CFO Colette Kress flatly denied on CNBC's Mad Money that the company is propping up neocloud buyers that may not be investment grade, rejecting the claim that it is turning to such customers because it is losing hyperscaler business. She said hyperscalers are currently pushing hard to secure more of Nvidia's available compute.

item.title: Gree's Dong Mingzhu Seeks Robotics Partners at APEC Summit
item.description:

Gree previously said it can self-develop humanoid robots and all their components, with more than 2,000 self-built industrial robots deployed and a load range spanning 1kg to 600kg.

item.title: Stanford Finds All 8 LLMs Favor Their Own Medical Answers as Judges
item.description:
A new Stanford paper had eight models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Qwen answer 620 real clinician questions, then rank all eight answers anonymously. Every judge favored its own answer, by 1.22 rank positions on average and nearly 3 for GPT-5.6 Sol. The bias persisted without a rubric, and revealing model names cut it by only 0.094 positions, implying LLM-as-judge medical benchmarks carry systematic self-preference. The authors recommend multi-family judge panels with per-judge reporting instead of one pooled score.

原文标题：斯坦福发现 8 款大模型评审医学答案时集体偏袒自身

Why it matters：直接动摇 LLM-as-judge 评测范式的可信度，对做医学评测与模型选型的人有立即可用的方法论修正。

item.title: Tencent Open-Sources Hy4 flash with 224B Total Parameters
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan has officially open-sourced the Hy4 flash family, including the standard, FP8, and Base variants, available on GitHub, Hugging Face, ModelScope, and GitCode. The model carries 224B total parameters (including 64B Engram parameters) while activating only 12B per token, supports multimodal input and a 1M-token context window, and is positioned as the most cost-effective Hy model to date, already deployed across Tencent Cloud TokenHub, Yuanbao, WeCom, and other products. Tencent also teased that the full Hy4 model is being open-sourced soon.

原文标题：腾讯开源 Hy4 flash 模型 224B 总参数激活 12B

Why it matters：国产大厂稀疏激活旗舰模型开源，参数规模与百万上下文规格明确，可直接下载部署。

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon Benchmarks Show Hour-Long Task Runtimes
item.description:
A private benchmark found Gemini 4 Carbon taking nearly an hour on tasks that Opus and Astra finish in minutes, with users widely reporting it as nearly unusable. Step-level tracing attributes the slowness to over-auditing unrelated code and mechanical inefficiencies such as fewer tool calls per step and frequent re-reading, whose fix alone could cut runtime by roughly a quarter.

item.title: Two AI Models Build Explorable Miami 3D Scene From Single Prompt
item.description:
Artificial Analysis prompted Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.2 Astra, each with a single prompt in the offline AA-3D sandbox, to build a GTA VI-themed Miami scene. Both models populated Ocean Drive with real hotels the prompt never named, including the Colony and the Avalon, and produced scenes explorable by car, speedboat or blimp at sunset or night. The test highlights implicit spatial memory of real cities and interactive 3D generation in frontier models without internet access.

原文标题：两大模型单提示词生成可探索迈阿密 3D 场景

Why it matters：以对照实验方式展示两大前沿模型在离线条件下生成可交互真实城市 3D 场景的能力，具备直观的技术参考价值。

item.title: Rockchip RK3668 Specs Leak with 44 TOPS NPU and 2027 Sampling
item.description:
A Rockchip document shared by open-hardware maker Radxa details the next-gen RK3668 general-purpose SoC: 6nm process, 6x Cortex-A725 plus 2x Cortex-A520 CPU cores, Mali G2 Pro MC4 GPU, and a self-developed NPU rated at 44 TOPS INT8 sparse compute, alongside early LPDDR6-10667 and PCIe Gen5 support. Aimed at edge AI and multimedia devices, engineering samples are slated for Q1 2027, making this a relatively long-range roadmap disclosure.

item.title: US Commerce Tightens AI Chip Exports to Five Nations Requiring Licenses
item.description:
The US Commerce Department will require licenses for AI chip shipments to Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Singapore and Brazil, extending controls from physical chips to rented compute in overseas data centers. The rule sets a 12 million total processing performance threshold (roughly 760 Nvidia H100s) to close the loophole used by China-headquartered firms, sending AMD and CoreWeave shares down about 5%.

Buyers without investment-grade ratings must now demonstrate solid offtake, meaning paying users for the chips they order, signaling a shift from loose ecosystem investing toward demand-anchored risk control.

item.title: iFixit Teardown Finds Apple HomeView Hard to Repair in Both Versions
item.description:
iFixit tore down Apple's first smart home hub, HomeView, revealing differences between the desktop and wall-mounted versions: the desktop model has a larger rear speaker and a built-in subwoofer in its base, while the wall version uses a smaller speaker and a more sealed chassis. Both are held together by heavy glue and thermal adhesive with very short cables, making the display, speakers and logic board nearly impossible to remove without damage, and the A18 chip, 8GB RAM and 64GB NAND are soldered directly to the board.

原文标题：iFixit 拆解苹果 HomeView 两款版本均难维修

item.title: AMD Completes Taalas Acquisition to Fold Inference ASIC Into Accelerator Roadmap
item.description:
AMD has closed its acquisition of Taalas, a startup building dedicated AI inference chips, and plans to fold the technology into its accelerator roadmap alongside Instinct GPUs as system-level inference solutions. Taalas hard-wires AI models onto ASICs optimized for specific model workloads, trading generality for markedly higher inference efficiency. The deal fills a gap in AMD's full-stack inference portfolio and signals a long-term strategy of blending model-specific silicon with general-purpose GPUs.

原文标题：AMD 完成收购 Taalas 整合推理 ASIC 路线
